hero.title:
Welcome to
Mayrwirt
hero.subtitle: Bavarian hospitality, honest cuisine and a home for guests from near and far.
rest.label: Restaurant
rest.title: Hearty Bavarian Cuisine
rest.desc1: At Mayrwirt we serve what the region has to offer — honest homestyle cooking, freshly prepared from seasonal ingredients. Whether Schweinsbraten, Wiener Schnitzel or daily specials: you can taste the difference.
rest.desc2: Our cosy dining room accommodates family celebrations, group outings and company events. We look forward to your reservation.
rooms.label: Accommodation
rooms.title: Rooms & Breakfast
rooms.subtitle: Rest in our cosy rooms — ideal as a base for trips to Salzburg and the Berchtesgaden area.
rooms.breakfastDesc: Start your day relaxed with our generous Bavarian breakfast buffet — featuring homemade products from our own butcher shop.
butch.label: Butcher Shop
butch.title: Craft with Passion
butch.desc1: Our in-house butcher shop stands for quality and tradition. We process regional meat into homemade sausages, ham and specialities.
butch.desc2: Our butcher products appear directly on your plate — and are also available to take home.
area.label: Area
area.title: Perfectly Located
area.subtitle: Saaldorf is situated between Salzburg and Berchtesgaden — a perfect base for your explorations.
area.salzburgDesc: Just 20 km away — Mozart's birthplace with fortress, old town and world-famous festival.
area.berchtDesc: 30 km to the national park, Königssee and Watzmann — hiking paradise in every season.
area.cyclingDesc: Right on the Inn cycle path — one of Bavaria's most beautiful cycling routes.
area.skiDesc: Hochkönig, Lofer and Reit im Winkl are about 45 minutes away.
area.lakeDesc: Several lakes nearby invite you to swim and relax in summer.
area.cultureDesc: Herrenchiemsee Castle, Kloster Seeon and many more regional treasures await.
contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Come Visit Us
contact.subtitle: Reservations, room enquiries and feedback — we look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.label: Careers
jobs.title: Join the Mayrwirt Team
jobs.subtitle: We are looking for motivated team members to join our family-run guesthouse.
jobs.contact: Send your application to office@mayrwirt.com or call us at +49 8654 69 03 90.
job1.title: Housekeeping Staff (m/f/d)
job1.desc: You will be responsible for cleaning and maintaining our guest rooms, ensuring every guest enjoys a comfortable and welcoming stay from the very first moment.
job2.title: Butcher Shop Sales Assistant (m/f/d)
job2.desc: You will advise customers at the counter, assist with the presentation of our home-made meat and sausage products, and be the friendly face of our butcher's shop.
